passives.name: Maritime Protection
passives.description: (Passive Effect) When hit, if the caster is granted a buff, reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by [Buff_V_4044003_4_3_2]. Increases damage taken from Light enemies and reduces damage dealt to them. Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from non-Light enemies by [Buff_V_armor_common_1], increases damage dealt to them, and reduces damage taken from them. Cursed/fixed damage taken by the Boss does not exceed [Buff_V_armor_common_3].

buffs.summary: −50% damage to boss if attacker has no element advantage/disadvantage
+15% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
